      ```
                    Evaluator.AssignType type,
                    String attr)
                      throws SCXMLExpressionException
      ```

      **Description copied from interface: `Evaluator`**

      Assigns data to a location

      **Specified by:**
      :   `evalAssign` in interface `Evaluator`

      Parameters:
      :   `ctx` - variable context
      :   `location` - location expression
      :   `data` - the data to assign.
      :   `type` - the type of assignment to perform, null assumes [`Evaluator.AssignType.REPLACE_CHILDREN`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Evaluator.AssignType.html#REPLACE_CHILDREN)
      :   `attr` - the name of the attribute to add when using type [`Evaluator.AssignType.ADD_ATTRIBUTE`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Evaluator.AssignType.html#ADD_ATTRIBUTE)

      Throws:
      :   `SCXMLExpressionException` - A malformed expression exception

      See Also:
      :   [`Evaluator.evalAssign(Context, String, Object, AssignType, String)`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Evaluator.html#evalAssign(org.apache.commons.scxml2.Context,%20java.lang.String,%20java.lang.Object,%20org.apache.commons.scxml2.Evaluator.AssignType,%20java.lang.String))
    * #### evalScript

      ```
      public Object evalScript(Context ctx,
                      String script)
                        throws SCXMLExpressionException
      ```

      Executes the script using a new Javascript engine obtained from
      factory instantiated in the constructor. The engine is supplied with
      a new JSBindings that includes the SCXML Context and
      `Data()` functions are replaced with an equivalent internal
      Javascript function.

      **Specified by:**
      :   `evalScript` in interface `Evaluator`

      Parameters:
      :   `ctx` - SCXML context.
      :   `script` - Script to execute.

      Returns:
      :   Result of script execution or `null`.

      Throws:
      :   `SCXMLExpressionException` - Thrown if the script was invalid.
    * #### getEffectiveContext

      ```
      protected JSContext getEffectiveContext(JSContext nodeCtx)
      ```

      Create a new context which is the summation of contexts from the
      current state to document root, child has priority over parent
      in scoping rules.

      Parameters:
      :   `nodeCtx` - The JexlContext for this state.

      Returns:
      :   The effective JexlContext for the path leading up to
          document root.

  ```
  public class JSBindings
  extends Object
  implements Bindings
  ```

  Wrapper class for the JDK Javascript engine Bindings class that extends the
  wrapped Bindings to search the SCXML context for variables and predefined
  functions that do not exist in the wrapped Bindings.

  ```
  public class SimpleSCXMLInvoker
  extends Object
  implements Invoker, Serializable
  ```

  A simple [`Invoker`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/invoke/Invoker.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2.invoke") for SCXML documents. Invoked SCXML document
  may not contain external namespace elements, further invokes etc.

* * ### Constructor Detail

    * #### PayloadProvider

      ```
      public PayloadProvider()
      ```
  * ### Method Detail

    * #### addToPayload

      ```
      protected void addToPayload(String attrName,
                      Object attrValue,
                      Map<String,Object> payload)
      ```

      Adds an attribute and value to a payload data map.

      As the SCXML specification allows for multiple payload attributes with the same name, this
      method takes care of merging multiple values for the same attribute in a list of values.

      Furthermore, as modifications of payload data on either the sender or receiver side should affect the
      the other side, attribute values (notably: [`Node`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/org/w3c/dom/Node.html?is-external=true "class or interface in org.w3c.dom") value only for now) is cloned first before being added
      to the payload data map. This includes 'nested' values within a [`NodeList`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/org/w3c/dom/NodeList.html?is-external=true "class or interface in org.w3c.dom"), [`List`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/util/List.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.util") or [`Map`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/util/Map.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.util").

      Parameters:
      :   `attrName` - the name of the attribute to add
      :   `attrValue` - the value of the attribute to add
      :   `payload` - the payload data map to be updated
    * #### clonePayloadValue

      ```
      protected Object clonePayloadValue(Object value)
      ```

      Clones a value object for adding to a payload data map.

      Currently only clones [`Node`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/org/w3c/dom/Node.html?is-external=true "class or interface in org.w3c.dom") values.

      If the value object is an instanceof [`NodeList`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/org/w3c/dom/NodeList.html?is-external=true "class or interface in org.w3c.dom"), [`List`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/util/List.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.util") or [`Map`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/util/Map.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.util"), its elements
      are also cloned (if possible) through recursive invocation of this same method, and put in
      a new [`List`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/util/List.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.util") or [`Map`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/util/Map.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.util") before returning.

      Parameters:
      :   `value` - the value to be cloned

      Returns:
      :   the cloned value if it could be cloned or otherwise the unmodified value parameter
    * #### makeEventPayload

      ```
      protected Object makeEventPayload(Evaluator evaluator,
                            Map<String,Object> payload)
                                 throws ModelException
      ```

      Converts a payload data map to be used for an event payload.

      Event payload involving key-value pair attributes for an xpath datamodel requires special handling as the
      attributes needs to be contained and put in a "data" element under a 'root' Event payload element.

      For non-xpath datamodels this method simply returns the original payload parameter unmodified.

      Parameters:
      :   `evaluator` - the evaluator to test for which datamodel type this event payload is intended
      :   `payload` - the payload data map

      Returns:
      :   payload for an event

      Throws:
      :   `ModelException`

  :   [SCXMLExecutionContext](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/SCXMLExecutionContext.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2"), [SCXMLExecutor](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/SCXMLExecutor.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2")

  ---

    

  ```
  public interface SCXMLIOProcessor
  ```

  The SCXML I/O Processor provides the interface for either an internal process or an external system or invoked child
  SCXML process ([`Invoker`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/invoke/Invoker.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2.invoke")) to send events into the SCXML processor queue.

    * #### getEvaluator

      ```
      public Evaluator getEvaluator(SCXML document)
      ```

      **Description copied from interface: `EvaluatorProvider`**

      Factory method to return a dedicated and optimized [`Evaluator`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Evaluator.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2") instance for a specific SCXML document.

      As the returned Evaluator *might* be optimized and dedicated for the SCXML document instance, the
      Evaluator may not be shareable and reusable for other SCXML documents.

      **Specified by:**
      :   `getEvaluator` in interface `EvaluatorProvider`

      Parameters:
      :   `document` - the SCXML document

      Returns:
      :   a new and not sharable Evaluator instance

  ---

    

  ```
  public class If
  extends Action
  implements ActionsContainer
  ```

  The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the
  <if> SCXML element, which serves as a container for conditionally
  executed elements. <else> and <elseif> can optionally
  appear within an <if> as immediate children, and serve to partition
  the elements within an <if>.

  See Also:
  :   [Serialized Form](../../../../../serialized-form.html#org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.If)

## Class EvaluatorFactory

* [java.lang.Object](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/Object.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang")
* * org.apache.commons.scxml2.EvaluatorFactory

* ---

    

  ```
  public class EvaluatorFactory
  extends Object
  ```

  A static singleton factory for [`EvaluatorProvider`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/EvaluatorProvider.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2")s by supported SCXML datamodel type.

  The EvaluatorFactory is used to automatically create an [`Evaluator`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Evaluator.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2") instance for an SCXML
  statemachine when none has been pre-defined and configured for the [`SCXMLExecutor`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/SCXMLExecutor.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2").

  The builtin supported providers are:
  * no or empty datamodel (default) or datamodel="jexl": `JexlEvaluator.JexlEvaluatorProvider`
  * datamodel="ecmascript": `JSEvaluator.JSEvaluatorProvider`
  * datamodel="groovy": `GroovyEvaluator.GroovyEvaluatorProvider`
  * datamodel="xpath": `XPathEvaluator.XPathEvaluatorProvider`
  * datamodel="null": `MinimalEvaluator.MinimalEvaluatorProvider`

  For adding additional or overriding the builtin Evaluator implementations use
  [`registerEvaluatorProvider(EvaluatorProvider)`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/EvaluatorFactory.html#registerEvaluatorProvider(org.apache.commons.scxml2.EvaluatorProvider)) or [`unregisterEvaluatorProvider(String)`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/EvaluatorFactory.html#unregisterEvaluatorProvider(java.lang.String)).

  The default provider can be overridden using the [`setDefaultProvider(EvaluatorProvider)`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/EvaluatorFactory.html#setDefaultProvider(org.apache.commons.scxml2.EvaluatorProvider)) which will
  register the provider under the [`Evaluator.DEFAULT_DATA_MODEL`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Evaluator.html#DEFAULT_DATA_MODEL) ("") value for the datamodel.  
  Note: this is *not* the same as datamodel="null"!

      Factory method to return a dedicated and optimized [`Evaluator`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Evaluator.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2") instance for a specific SCXML document.

      As the returned Evaluator *might* be optimized and dedicated for the SCXML document instance, the
      Evaluator may not be shareable and reusable for other SCXML documents.

      **Specified by:**
      :   `getEvaluator` in interface `EvaluatorProvider`

      Parameters:
      :   `document` - the SCXML document

      Returns:
      :   a new and not sharable Evaluator instance

## Class SimpleDispatcher

* [java.lang.Object](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/Object.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang")
* * org.apache.commons.scxml2.env.SimpleDispatcher

* All Implemented Interfaces:
  :   [Serializable](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/io/Serializable.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.io"), [EventDispatcher](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/EventDispatcher.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2")

  ---

    

  ```
  public class SimpleDispatcher
  extends Object
  implements EventDispatcher, Serializable
  ```

  EventDispatcher implementation that can schedule `delay`ed
  <send> events for the "scxml" `type`
  attribute value (which is also the default). This implementation uses
  J2SE `Timer`s.

  No other `type`s are processed. Subclasses may support
  additional `type`s by overriding the
  `send(...)` and `cancel(...)` methods and
  delegating to their `super` counterparts for the
  "scxml" `type`.

  See Also:
  :   [Serialized Form](../../../../../serialized-form.html#org.apache.commons.scxml2.env.SimpleDispatcher)

      :   `type` - The type of the Event I/O Processor that the event should

      :   `event` - The type of event being generated.

      :   `hints` - The data containing information which may be
          used by the implementing platform to configure the event processor
      :   `delay` - The event is dispatched after the delay interval elapses

## Class SimpleTransition

* [java.lang.Object](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/Object.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang")
* * [org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.Executable](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/Executable.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model")
  * * org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.SimpleTransition

* All Implemented Interfaces:
  :   [Serializable](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/io/Serializable.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.io"), [NamespacePrefixesHolder](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/NamespacePrefixesHolder.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model"), [Observable](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/Observable.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model")

  Direct Known Subclasses:
  :   [Transition](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/Transition.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model")

  ---

    

  ```
  public class SimpleTransition
  extends Executable
  implements NamespacePrefixesHolder, Observable
  ```

  The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the
  simple <transition> SCXML element, without Transition rules for "events" or
  "guard-conditions". Used for <history> or <history> elements.

  See Also:
  :   [Serialized Form](../../../../../serialized-form.html#org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.SimpleTransition)

    * #### isTypeInternal

      ```
      public final boolean isTypeInternal()
      ```

      Returns the effective Transition type.

      A transition type is only effectively internal if:
      * its [`getType()`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/SimpleTransition.html#getType()) == [`TransitionType.internal`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/TransitionType.html#internal)
      * its source state [`getParent()`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/SimpleTransition.html#getParent()) [`State.isComposite()`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/State.html#isComposite())
      * all its [`getTargets()`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/SimpleTransition.html#getTargets()) are proper descendants of its [`getParent()`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/SimpleTransition.html#getParent())Otherwise it is treated (for determining its exit states) as if it is of type [`TransitionType.external`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/TransitionType.html#external)

      Returns:
      :   true if the effective Transition type is [`TransitionType.internal`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/TransitionType.html#internal)

      See Also:
      :   <http://www.w3.org/TR/2014/CR-scxml-20140313/#SelectingTransitions>
    * #### getTransitionDomain

      ```
      public TransitionalState getTransitionDomain()
      ```

      Returns the transition domain of this transition

      If this transition is target-less OR if its transition domain is the SCXML document itself, null is returned.

      This method therefore only is useful to be invoked if the transition has targets!

      If the transition has targets then the transition domain is the compound State parent such that:
      * all states that are exited or entered as a result of taking this transition are descendants of it
      * no descendant of it has this propertyIf there is no such compound state parent, the transition domain effectively becomes the SCXML document itself,
      which is not a (Transitional)State, and thus null will be returned instead.

      Returns:
      :   The transition domain of this transition

  ```
  public class SCXML
  ```

  The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the
  <scxml> root element, and serves as the "document
  root".

  See Also:
  :   [Serialized Form](../../../../../serialized-form.html#org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.SCXML)

    * #### getEvaluator

      ```
      public Evaluator getEvaluator()
      ```

      Returns:
      :   a default or generic [`Evaluator`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Evaluator.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2") supporting the [`EvaluatorProvider.getSupportedDatamodel()`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/EvaluatorProvider.html#getSupportedDatamodel())
    * #### getEvaluator

      ```
      public Evaluator getEvaluator(SCXML document)
      ```

      **Description copied from interface: `EvaluatorProvider`**

      Factory method to return a dedicated and optimized [`Evaluator`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Evaluator.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2") instance for a specific SCXML document.

      As the returned Evaluator *might* be optimized and dedicated for the SCXML document instance, the
      Evaluator may not be shareable and reusable for other SCXML documents.

      **Specified by:**
      :   `getEvaluator` in interface `EvaluatorProvider`

      Parameters:
      :   `document` - the SCXML document

      Returns:
      :   a new and not sharable Evaluator instance

## Class SCXMLReader.Configuration

* [java.lang.Object](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/Object.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang")
* * org.apache.commons.scxml2.io.SCXMLReader.Configuration

* Enclosing class:
  :   [SCXMLReader](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/io/SCXMLReader.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.io")

  ---

    

  ```
  public static class SCXMLReader.Configuration
  extends Object
  ```

  Configuration for the [`SCXMLReader`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/io/SCXMLReader.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.io"). The configuration properties necessary for the following are
  covered:

  * [`XMLInputFactory`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLInputFactory.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream") configuration properties such as [`XMLReporter`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLReporter.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream"), [`XMLResolver`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLResolver.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream") and
    [`XMLEventAllocator`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/util/XMLEventAllocator.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream.util")
  * [`XMLStreamReader`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLStreamReader.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream") configuration properties such as `systemId` and `encoding`
  * Commons SCXML object model configuration properties such as the list of custom actions and the
    [`PathResolver`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/PathResolver.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2") to use.

    * #### SCXMLReader.Configuration

      ```
      public SCXMLReader.Configuration(String factoryId,
                               ClassLoader classLoader,
                               XMLEventAllocator allocator,
                               Map<String,Object> properties,
                               XMLResolver resolver,
                               XMLReporter reporter,
                               String encoding,
                               String systemId,
                               boolean validate,
                               PathResolver pathResolver,
                               List<CustomAction> customActions,
                               ClassLoader customActionClassLoader,
                               boolean useContextClassLoaderForCustomActions)
      ```

      All purpose constructor. Any of the parameters passed in can be `null` (booleans should default
      to `false`).

      Parameters:
      :   `factoryId` - The `factoryId` to use.
      :   `classLoader` - The [`ClassLoader`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/ClassLoader.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang") to use for the [`XMLInputFactory`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLInputFactory.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream") instance to create.
      :   `allocator` - The [`XMLEventAllocator`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/util/XMLEventAllocator.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream.util") for the [`XMLInputFactory`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLInputFactory.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream").
      :   `properties` - The map of properties (keys are property name strings, values are object property values)
          for the [`XMLInputFactory`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLInputFactory.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream").
      :   `resolver` - The [`XMLResolver`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLResolver.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream") for the [`XMLInputFactory`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLInputFactory.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream").
      :   `reporter` - The [`XMLReporter`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLReporter.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream") for the [`XMLInputFactory`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLInputFactory.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream").
      :   `encoding` - The `encoding` to use for the [`XMLStreamReader`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLStreamReader.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream")
      :   `systemId` - The `systemId` to use for the [`XMLStreamReader`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLStreamReader.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream")
      :   `validate` - Whether to validate the input with the XML Schema for SCXML.
      :   `pathResolver` - The Commons SCXML [`PathResolver`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/PathResolver.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2") to use for this document.
      :   `customActions` - The list of Commons SCXML custom actions that will be available for this document.
      :   `customActionClassLoader` - The [`ClassLoader`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/ClassLoader.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang") to use for the [`CustomAction`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/CustomAction.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model") instances to
          create.
      :   `useContextClassLoaderForCustomActions` - Whether to use the thread context [`ClassLoader`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/ClassLoader.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang") for the
          [`CustomAction`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/CustomAction.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model") instances to create.

## Class StandaloneUtils

* [java.lang.Object](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/Object.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang")
* * org.apache.commons.scxml2.test.StandaloneUtils

* ---

    

  ```
  public final class StandaloneUtils
  extends Object
  ```

  Utility methods used by command line SCXML execution, useful for
  debugging.
  The following expression languages are supported in SCXML documents:
  1. JEXL - Using Commons JEXL

  See Also:
  :   [`org.apache.commons.scxml2.env.jexl`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/env/jexl/package-summary.html)

* * ### Method Summary

    Methods

    | Modifier and Type | Method and Description |
    | `static void` | `execute(String uri, Evaluator evaluator)` Command line utility method for executing the state machine defined using the SCXML document described by the specified URI and using the specified expression evaluator. |

    * ### Methods inherited from class java.lang.[Object](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/Object.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang")

      `clone, equals, finalize, getClass, hashCode, notify, notifyAll, toString, wait, wait, wait`

* * ### Method Detail

    * #### execute

      ```
      public static void execute(String uri,
                 Evaluator evaluator)
      ```

      Command line utility method for executing the state machine defined
      using the SCXML document described by the specified URI and using
      the specified expression evaluator.

      Parameters:
      :   `uri` - The URI or filename of the SCXML document
      :   `evaluator` - The expression evaluator for the expression language
          used in the specified SCXML document

          RUNNING:

          * Enter a space-separated list of "events"
          * To quit, enter "quit"
          * To populate a variable in the current context,
            type "name=value"
          * To reset state machine, enter "reset"

      :   An [`Invoker`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/invoke/Invoker.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2.invoke") for the specified type, if an
          invoker class is registered against that type,
          `null` otherwise.

      Throws:
      :   `InvokerException` - When a suitable [`Invoker`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/invoke/Invoker.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2.invoke") cannot be instantiated.
    * #### getInvoker

      ```
      public Invoker getInvoker(Invoke invoke)
      ```

      Get the [`Invoker`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/invoke/Invoker.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2.invoke") for this [`Invoke`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/Invoke.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model").
      May return `null`. A non-null [`Invoker`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/invoke/Invoker.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2.invoke") will be
      returned if and only if the [`Invoke`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/Invoke.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model") parent TransitionalState is

## Class SCXMLWriter.Configuration

* [java.lang.Object](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/Object.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang")
* * org.apache.commons.scxml2.io.SCXMLWriter.Configuration

* Enclosing class:
  :   [SCXMLWriter](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/io/SCXMLWriter.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.io")

  ---

    

  ```
  public static class SCXMLWriter.Configuration
  extends Object
  ```

  Configuration for the [`SCXMLWriter`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/io/SCXMLWriter.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.io"). The configuration properties necessary for the following are
  covered:

  * [`XMLOutputFactory`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLOutputFactory.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream") configuration properties such as `factoryId` or any properties
  * [`XMLStreamWriter`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLStreamWriter.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream") configuration properties such as target [`Writer`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/io/Writer.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.io") or [`OutputStream`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/io/OutputStream.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.io")
    and the `encoding`

* * ### Constructor Summary

    Constructors

    | Constructor and Description |
    | `SCXMLWriter.Configuration()` Default constructor. |
    | `SCXMLWriter.Configuration(String factoryId, ClassLoader factoryClassLoader, Map<String,Object> properties, String encoding, boolean usePrettyPrint, boolean closeUnderlyingWhenDone)` All-purpose constructor. |
  * ### Method Summary

    * ### Methods inherited from class java.lang.[Object](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/Object.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang")

      `clone, equals, finalize, getClass, hashCode, notify, notifyAll, toString, wait, wait, wait`

* * ### Constructor Detail

    * #### SCXMLWriter.Configuration

      ```
      public SCXMLWriter.Configuration()
      ```

      Default constructor.
    * #### SCXMLWriter.Configuration

      ```
      public SCXMLWriter.Configuration(String factoryId,
                               ClassLoader factoryClassLoader,
                               Map<String,Object> properties,
                               String encoding,
                               boolean usePrettyPrint,
                               boolean closeUnderlyingWhenDone)
      ```

      All-purpose constructor. Any of the parameters passed in can be `null` (booleans should default
      to `false`). At the moment, the `factoryId` and `factoryClassLoader`
      arguments are effectively ignored due to a bug in the underlying StAX [`XMLOutputFactory`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLOutputFactory.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream") API.

      Parameters:
      :   `factoryId` - The `factoryId` to use.
      :   `factoryClassLoader` - The [`ClassLoader`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/ClassLoader.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang") to use for the [`XMLOutputFactory`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLOutputFactory.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream") instance to
          create.
      :   `properties` - The map of properties (keys are property name strings, values are object property values)
          for the [`XMLOutputFactory`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLOutputFactory.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream").
      :   `encoding` - The `encoding` to use for the [`XMLStreamWriter`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/javax/xml/stream/XMLStreamWriter.html?is-external=true "class or interface in javax.xml.stream")
      :   `usePrettyPrint` - Whether to make the output human readable as far as possible. Since StAX does not
          provide a portable way to do this in JDK 1.6, choosing the pretty print option
          is currently not very efficient.
      :   `closeUnderlyingWhenDone` - Whether to close the underlying stream or writer passed by the caller.

## Interface DocumentOrder

* All Known Implementing Classes:
  :   [EnterableState](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/EnterableState.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model"), [Final](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/Final.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model"), [Parallel](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/Parallel.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model"), [State](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/State.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model"), [Transition](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/Transition.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model"), [TransitionalState](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/TransitionalState.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model")

  ---

    

  ```
  public interface DocumentOrder
  ```

  DocumentOrder is implemented by [`EnterableState`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/EnterableState.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model") and [`Transition`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/Transition.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model") elements in the SCXML document
  representing their document order,

  They are ordered with ancestor states before their descendant states,
  and the transitions within a state in document order before any descendant states.

  Note: it is assumed there will be no more than Integer.MAX\_VALUE of such elements in a single SCXML document

* * ### Method Detail

    * #### getSupportedDatamodel

      ```
      String getSupportedDatamodel()
      ```

      Returns:
      :   The SCXML datamodel type this provider supports
    * #### getEvaluator

      ```
      Evaluator getEvaluator()
      ```

      Returns:
      :   a default or generic [`Evaluator`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Evaluator.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2") supporting the [`getSupportedDatamodel()`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/EvaluatorProvider.html#getSupportedDatamodel())
    * #### getEvaluator

      ```
      Evaluator getEvaluator(SCXML document)
      ```

      Factory method to return a dedicated and optimized [`Evaluator`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Evaluator.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2") instance for a specific SCXML document.

      As the returned Evaluator *might* be optimized and dedicated for the SCXML document instance, the
      Evaluator may not be shareable and reusable for other SCXML documents.

      Parameters:
      :   `document` - the SCXML document

      Returns:
      :   a new and not sharable Evaluator instance

  A map that will back the effective [`Context`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Context.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2") for an [`Evaluator`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Evaluator.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2") execution.
  The effective context enables the chaining of contexts all the way from the current state node to the root.

  See Also:
  :   [Serialized Form](../../../../../serialized-form.html#org.apache.commons.scxml2.env.EffectiveContextMap)

  ---

    

  ```
  public class OnExit
  extends Executable
  ```

  The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the
  <onexit> SCXML element, which is an optional property
  holding executable content to be run upon exiting the parent
  State or Parallel.

  See Also:
  :   [Serialized Form](../../../../../serialized-form.html#org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.OnExit)

## Class MinimalContext

* [java.lang.Object](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/Object.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang")
* * [org.apache.commons.scxml2.env.SimpleContext](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/env/SimpleContext.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.env")
  * * org.apache.commons.scxml2.env.minimal.MinimalContext

* All Implemented Interfaces:
  :   [Serializable](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/io/Serializable.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.io"), [Context](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/Context.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2")

  ---

    

  ```
  public class MinimalContext
  extends SimpleContext
  ```

  MinimalContext implementation for the SCXML Null Data Model.

  This context disables any access to the parent context (other than through getParent()) and
  ignores setting any local data.

  The MinimalContext requires a none MinimalContext based parent Context for creation.
  If the parent context is of type MinimalContext, *its* parent will be used as the parent of the
  new MinimalContext instance

  See Also:
  :   [Serialized Form](../../../../../../serialized-form.html#org.apache.commons.scxml2.env.minimal.MinimalContext)

## Class SCXMLSystemContext

* [java.lang.Object](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/Object.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang")
* * org.apache.commons.scxml2.SCXMLSystemContext

* All Implemented Interfaces:

  ---

    

  ```
  public class SCXMLSystemContext
  extends Object
  implements Context, Serializable
  ```

  The SCXMLSystemContext is used as a read only Context wrapper
  and provides the SCXML (read only) system variables which are injected via the unwrapped [`getContext()`](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/SCXMLSystemContext.html#getContext()).

  See Also:
  :   <http://www.w3.org/TR/scxml/#SystemVariables>,
      [Serialized Form](../../../../serialized-form.html#org.apache.commons.scxml2.SCXMLSystemContext)

## Class StandaloneJexlExpressions

* [java.lang.Object](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/Object.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang")
* * org.apache.commons.scxml2.test.StandaloneJexlExpressions

* ---

    

  ```
  public final class StandaloneJexlExpressions
  extends Object
  ```

  Standalone SCXML interpreter, useful for command-line testing and
  debugging, where expressions are JEXL expressions.

  USAGE:

  `java org.apache.commons.scxml2.test.StandaloneJexlExpressions
  url`

  or

  `java org.apache.commons.scxml2.test.StandaloneJexlExpressions
  filename`

  RUNNING:

  * Enter a space-separated list of "events"
  * To quit, enter "quit"
  * To populate a variable in the current context,
    type "name=value"
  * To reset state machine, enter "reset"

## Class Parallel

* [java.lang.Object](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/Object.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang")
* * [org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.TransitionTarget](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/TransitionTarget.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model")

    * * [org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.TransitionalState](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/TransitionalState.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model")
      * * org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.Parallel

* All Implemented Interfaces:
  :   [Serializable](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/io/Serializable.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.io"), [DocumentOrder](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/DocumentOrder.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model"), [Observable](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/model/Observable.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2.model")

  ---

    

  ```
  public class Parallel
  extends TransitionalState
  ```

  The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the
  <parallel> SCXML element, which is a wrapper element to
  encapsulate parallel state machines. For the <parallel> element
  to be useful, each of its <state> substates must itself be
  complex, that is, one with either <state> or <parallel>
  children.

  See Also:
  :   [Serialized Form](../../../../../serialized-form.html#org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.Parallel)

  The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the
  <foreach> SCXML element, which allows an SCXML application to iterate through a collection in the data model
  and to execute the actions contained within it for each item in the collection.

## Class GroovyExtendableScriptCache

* [java.lang.Object](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/lang/Object.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.lang")
* * org.apache.commons.scxml2.env.groovy.GroovyExtendableScriptCache

* All Implemented Interfaces:
  :   [Serializable](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/io/Serializable.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.io")

  ---

    

  ```
  public class GroovyExtendableScriptCache
  extends Object
  implements Serializable
  ```

  GroovyExtendableScriptCache is a general purpose and *[`Serializable`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/io/Serializable.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.io")* Groovy Script cache.

  It provides automatic compilation of scripts and caches the resulting class(es) internally, and after de-serialization
  re-compiles the cached scripts automatically.

  It also provides easy support for (and scoped) script compilation with a specific `Script` base class.

  Internally it uses a non-serializable and thus transient `GroovyClassLoader`, `CompilerConfiguration` and
  the parent classloader to use.  
  To be able to be serializable, the `GroovyClassLoader` is automatically (re)created if not defined yet, and for
  the `CompilerConfiguration` and parent classloader it uses serializable instances of
  [`GroovyExtendableScriptCache.CompilerConfigurationFactory`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/env/groovy/GroovyExtendableScriptCache.CompilerConfigurationFactory.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2.env.groovy") and [`GroovyExtendableScriptCache.ParentClassLoaderFactory`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/env/groovy/GroovyExtendableScriptCache.ParentClassLoaderFactory.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2.env.groovy") interfaces which either can be configured
  or have defaults otherwise.

  The underlying `GroovyClassLoader` can be accessed through [`getGroovyClassLoader()`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/env/groovy/GroovyExtendableScriptCache.html#getGroovyClassLoader()), which might be needed
  to de-serialize previously defined/created classes and objects through this class, from within a containing object
  readObject(ObjectInputStream in) method.  
  For more information how this works and should be done, see:
  [Groovy-1627: Deserialization fails to work](http://jira.codehaus.org/browse/GROOVY-1627)

  One other optional feature is script pre-processing which can be configured through an instance of the
  [`GroovyExtendableScriptCache.ScriptPreProcessor`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/env/groovy/GroovyExtendableScriptCache.ScriptPreProcessor.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml2.env.groovy") interface (also [`Serializable`](http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/io/Serializable.html?is-external=true "class or interface in java.io") of course).  
  When configured, the script source will be passed through the [`GroovyExtendableScriptCache.ScriptPreProcessor.preProcess(String)`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/env/groovy/GroovyExtendableScriptCache.ScriptPreProcessor.html#preProcess(java.lang.String)) method
  before being compiled.

  The cache itself as well as the underlying GroovyClassLoader caches can be cleared through [`clearCache()`](../../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml2/env/groovy/GroovyExtendableScriptCache.html#clearCache()).

  The GroovyExtendableScriptCache has no other external dependencies other than Groovy itself,
  so can be used independent of Commons SCXML.

  See Also:
  :   [Serialized Form](../../../../../../serialized-form.html#org.apache.commons.scxml2.env.groovy.GroovyExtendableScriptCache)

# How This API Document Is Organized

This API (Application Programming Interface) document has pages corresponding to the items in the navigation bar, described as follows.

### Overview

> The [Overview](overview-summary.html) page is the front page of this API document and provides a list of all packages with a summary for each. This page can also contain an overall description of the set of packages.

### Package

> Each package has a page that contains a list of its classes and interfaces, with a summary for each. This page can contain four categories:
>
> * Interfaces (italic)* Classes* Exceptions* Errors

### Class/Interface

> Each class, interface, nested class and nested interface has its own separate page. Each of these pages has three sections consisting of a class/interface description, summary tables, and detailed member descriptions:
>
> * Class inheritance diagram* Direct Subclasses* All Known Subinterfaces* All Known Implementing Classes* Class/interface declaration* Class/interface description
>
>             * Nested Class Summary* Field Summary* Constructor Summary* Method Summary
>
>                     * Field Detail* Constructor Detail* Method Detail
>
> Each summary entry contains the first sentence from the detailed description for that item. The summary entries are alphabetical, while the detailed descriptions are in the order they appear in the source code. This preserves the logical groupings established by the programmer.

### Use

> Each documented package, class and interface has its own Use page. This page describes what packages, classes, methods, constructors and fields use any part of the given class or package. Given a class or interface A, its Use page includes subclasses of A, fields declared as A, methods that return A, and methods and constructors with parameters of type A. You can access this page by first going to the package, class or interface, then clicking on the "Use" link in the navigation bar.

### Tree (Class Hierarchy)

> There is a [Class Hierarchy](overview-tree.html) page for all packages, plus a hierarchy for each package. Each hierarchy page contains a list of classes and a list of interfaces. The classes are organized by inheritance structure starting with `java.lang.Object`. The interfaces do not inherit from `java.lang.Object`.
>
> * When viewing the Overview page, clicking on "Tree" displays the hierarchy for all packages.* When viewing a particular package, class or interface page, clicking "Tree" displays the hierarchy for only that package.

### Deprecated API

> The [Deprecated API](deprecated-list.html) page lists all of the API that have been deprecated. A deprecated API is not recommended for use, generally due to improvements, and a replacement API is usually given. Deprecated APIs may be removed in future implementations.

### Index

> The [Index](index-all.html) contains an alphabetic list of all classes, interfaces, constructors, methods, and fields.

### Prev/Next

These links take you to the next or previous class, interface, package, or related page.

### Frames/No Frames

These links show and hide the HTML frames. All pages are available with or without frames.

### Serialized Form

Each serializable or externalizable class has a description of its serialization fields and methods. This information is of interest to re-implementors, not to developers using the API. While there is no link in the navigation bar, you can get to this information by going to any serialized class and clicking "Serialized Form" in the "See also" section of the class description.

*This help file applies to API documentation generated using the standard doclet.*

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml

The Commons SCXML executor and core concepts.

**See:**
  
          [**Description**](#package_description)

| **Interface Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[*Context*](Context.html)** | A Context or "scope" for storing variables; usually tied to a SCXML root or State object. |
| **[*ErrorReporter*](ErrorReporter.html)** | An interface for reporting SCXML errors to the host environment, containing the definition of commonly occuring errors while executing SCXML documents. |
| **[*Evaluator*](Evaluator.html)** | Interface for a component that may be used by the SCXML engines to evaluate the expressions within the SCXML document. |
| **[*EventDispatcher*](EventDispatcher.html)** | The event controller interface used to send messages containing events or other information directly to another SCXML Interpreter, other external systems using an Event I/O Processor or to raise events in the current SCXML session. |
| **[*PathResolver*](PathResolver.html)** | Interface for a component that may be used by the SCXML engines to resolve context sensitive paths. |
| **[*SCXMLListener*](SCXMLListener.html)** | Listener interface for observable entities in the SCXML model. |
| **[*SCXMLSemantics*](SCXMLSemantics.html)** | The purpose of this interface is to separate the interpretation algorithm from the `SCXMLExecutor` and therefore make it pluggable. |

| **Class Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[Builtin](Builtin.html)** | Implementations of builtin functions defined by the SCXML specification. |
| **[NotificationRegistry](NotificationRegistry.html)** | The registry where SCXML listeners are recorded for nodes of interest such as the `SCXML` root, `TransitionTarget`s and `Transition`s. |
| **[SCInstance](SCInstance.html)** | The `SCInstance` performs book-keeping functions for a particular execution of a state chart represented by a `SCXML` object. |
| **[SCXMLExecutor](SCXMLExecutor.html)** | The SCXML "engine" that executes SCXML documents. |
| **[SCXMLHelper](SCXMLHelper.html)** | Helper class, all methods static final. |
| **[Status](Status.html)** | The encapsulation of the current state of a state machine. |
| **[Step](Step.html)** | A logical unit of progression in the execution of a SCXML model. |
| **[TriggerEvent](TriggerEvent.html)** | A class representing an event. |

| **Exception Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[SCXMLExpressionException](SCXMLExpressionException.html)** | Exception thrown when a malformed expression is encountered during evaluation of an expression in a SCXML document. |

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml.model

A collection of classes needed to model SCXML documents.

**See:**
  
          [**Description**](#package_description)

| **Interface Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[*ExternalContent*](ExternalContent.html)** | An `ExternalContent` implementation represents an element in the SCXML document that may contain "body content", which means an arbitrary number of child nodes belonging to external namespaces. |
| **[*PathResolverHolder*](PathResolverHolder.html)** | A `PathResolverHolder` is an entity that holds a [`PathResolver`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/PathResolver.html). |

| **Class Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[Action](Action.html)** | An abstract base class for executable elements in SCXML, such as <assign>, <log> etc. |
| **[Assign](Assign.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <assign> SCXML element. |
| **[Cancel](Cancel.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <cancel> SCXML element. |
| **[CustomAction](CustomAction.html)** | A custom action is simply a tuple consisting of a namespace URI, the local name for the custom action and the corresponding [`Action`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Action.html) class. |
| **[Data](Data.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the SCXML <data> child element of the <datamodel> element. |
| **[Datamodel](Datamodel.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the SCXML <datamodel> element. |
| **[Else](Else.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <else> SCXML element. |
| **[ElseIf](ElseIf.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <elseif> SCXML element. |
| **[Executable](Executable.html)** | An abstract base class for containers of executable elements in SCXML, such as <onentry> and <onexit>. |
| **[Exit](Exit.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <exit> SCXML element, which is a shorthand notation for an empty anonymous final state. |
| **[Finalize](Finalize.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <finalize> SCXML element. |
| **[History](History.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <history> SCXML pseudo state element. |
| **[If](If.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <if> SCXML element, which serves as a container for conditionally executed elements. |
| **[Initial](Initial.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <initial> SCXML pseudo state element. |
| **[Invoke](Invoke.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <invoke> SCXML element. |
| **[Log](Log.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <log> SCXML element. |
| **[OnEntry](OnEntry.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <onentry> SCXML element, which is an optional property holding executable content to be run upon entering the parent State or Parallel. |
| **[OnExit](OnExit.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <onexit> SCXML element, which is an optional property holding executable content to be run upon exiting the parent State or Parallel. |
| **[Parallel](Parallel.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <parallel> SCXML element, which is a wrapper element to encapsulate parallel state machines. |
| **[Param](Param.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <param> SCXML element. |
| **[Path](Path.html)** | A helper class for this SCXML implementation that represents the path taken to transition from one TransitionTarget to another in the SCXML document. |
| **[SCXML](SCXML.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <scxml> root element, and serves as the "document root". |
| **[Send](Send.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <send> SCXML element. |
| **[State](State.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <state> SCXML element. |
| **[Transition](Transition.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <transition> SCXML element. |
| **[TransitionTarget](TransitionTarget.html)** | An abstract base class for elements in SCXML that can serve as a <target> for a <transition>, such as State or Parallel. |
| **[Var](Var.html)** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <var> SCXML element. |

| **Exception Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[ModelException](ModelException.html)** | Exception that is thrown when the SCXML model supplied to the executor has a fatal flaw that prevents the executor from further interpreting the the model. |

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml.model Description

A collection of classes needed to model SCXML documents.

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml.env

A collection of classes that may be commonly used to bridge the
SCXML executor to the runtime environment.

**See:**
  
          [**Description**](#package_description)

| **Class Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[AbstractStateMachine](AbstractStateMachine.html)** | This class demonstrates one approach for providing the base functionality needed by classes representing stateful entities, whose behaviors are defined via SCXML documents. |
| **[LogUtils](LogUtils.html)** | Helper methods for Commons SCXML logging. |
| **[SimpleContext](SimpleContext.html)** | Simple Context wrapping a map of variables. |
| **[SimpleDispatcher](SimpleDispatcher.html)** | Trivial EventDispatcher implementation. |
| **[SimpleErrorHandler](SimpleErrorHandler.html)** | Custom error handler that logs the parsing errors in the SCXML document. |
| **[SimpleErrorReporter](SimpleErrorReporter.html)** | Custom error reporter that log execution errors. |
| **[SimpleSCXMLListener](SimpleSCXMLListener.html)** | Simple SCXML Listener that logs execution. |
| **[Tracer](Tracer.html)** | A simple tracer connected to Apache Commons Logging. |
| **[URLResolver](URLResolver.html)** | A PathResolver implementation that resolves against a base URL. |

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml.env Description

A collection of classes that may be commonly used to bridge the
SCXML executor to the runtime environment.

Various sub-packages contain specifics related to a particular
environment.

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml.semantics

A collection of classes responsible for implementations of the
`org.apache.commons.scxml.SCXMLSemantics` interface.

**See:**
  
          [**Description**](#package_description)

| **Class Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[SCXMLSemanticsImpl](SCXMLSemanticsImpl.html)** | This class encapsulates a particular SCXML semantics, that is, a particular semantic interpretation of Harel Statecharts, which aligns mostly with W3C SCXML July 5 public draft (that is, UML 1.5). |

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml.semantics Description

A collection of classes responsible for implementations of the
`org.apache.commons.scxml.SCXMLSemantics` interface.

Some possible semantic interpretations are, for example:

* STATEMATE* RHAPSODY* ROOMCharts* UML 1.5* UML 2.0

Specific semantics can be created by subclassing
`org.apache.commons.scxml.semantics.SCXMLSemanticsImpl`,
which is the default implementation used.

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml.env.jsp Description

environment. An example of this usage can be found in the

[Reusable Dialog Components (RDC)](http://jakarta.apache.org/taglibs/doc/rdc-doc/intro.html) group container.

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml

The Commons SCXML executor and core concepts.

**See:**
  
          [**Description**](#package_description)

| **Interface Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[Context](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/Context.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | A Context or "scope" for storing variables; usually tied to a SCXML root or State object. |
| **[ErrorReporter](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/ErrorReporter.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | An interface for reporting SCXML errors to the host environment, containing the definition of commonly occuring errors while executing SCXML documents. |
| **[Evaluator](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/Evaluator.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | Interface for a component that may be used by the SCXML engines to evaluate the expressions within the SCXML document. |
| **[EventDispatcher](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/EventDispatcher.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | The event controller interface used to send messages containing events or other information directly to another SCXML Interpreter, other external systems using an Event I/O Processor or to raise events in the current SCXML session. |
| **[PathResolver](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/PathResolver.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | Interface for a component that may be used by the SCXML engines to resolve context sensitive paths. |
| **[SCXMLListener](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/SCXMLListener.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | Listener interface for observable entities in the SCXML model. |
| **[SCXMLSemantics](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/SCXMLSemantics.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | The purpose of this interface is to separate the interpretation algorithm from the `SCXMLExecutor` and therefore make it pluggable. |

| **Class Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[Builtin](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/Builtin.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | Implementations of builtin functions defined by the SCXML specification. |
| **[NotificationRegistry](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/NotificationRegistry.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | The registry where SCXML listeners are recorded for nodes of interest such as the `SCXML` root, `TransitionTarget`s and `Transition`s. |
| **[SCInstance](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/SCInstance.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | The `SCInstance` performs book-keeping functions for a particular execution of a state chart represented by a `SCXML` object. |
| **[SCXMLExecutor](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/SCXMLExecutor.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | The SCXML "engine" that executes SCXML documents. |
| **[SCXMLHelper](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/SCXMLHelper.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | Helper class, all methods static final. |
| **[Status](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/Status.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | The encapsulation of the current state of a state machine. |
| **[Step](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/Step.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | A logical unit of progression in the execution of a SCXML model. |
| **[TriggerEvent](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/TriggerEvent.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | A class representing an event. |

| **Exception Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[SCXMLExpressionException](../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/SCXMLExpressionException.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml")** | Exception thrown when a malformed expression is encountered during evaluation of an expression in a SCXML document. |

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml Description

The Commons SCXML executor and core concepts.

documents, to and from the Commons SCXML Java object model.

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml.env.jsp Description

A collection of classes bridging the SCXML executor to the JSP
environment. An example of this usage can be found in the
pluggable dialog management of the
[Reusable Dialog Components (RDC)](http://jakarta.apache.org/taglibs/doc/rdc-doc/intro.html) group container.

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml.semantics

A collection of classes responsible for implementations of the
`org.apache.commons.scxml.SCXMLSemantics` interface.

**See:**
  
          [**Description**](#package_description)

| **Class Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[ErrorConstants](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/semantics/ErrorConstants.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.semantics")** | Errors reported by the default SCXMLSemantics implementation. |
| **[SCXMLSemanticsImpl](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/semantics/SCXMLSemanticsImpl.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.semantics")** | This class encapsulates a particular SCXML semantics, that is, a particular semantic interpretation of Harel Statecharts, which aligns mostly with W3C SCXML July 5 public draft (that is, UML 1.5). |

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml.semantics Description

A collection of classes responsible for implementations of the
`org.apache.commons.scxml.SCXMLSemantics` interface.

Some possible semantic interpretations are, for example:

* STATEMATE* RHAPSODY* ROOMCharts* UML 1.5* UML 2.0

Specific semantics can be created by subclassing
`org.apache.commons.scxml.semantics.SCXMLSemanticsImpl`,
which is the default implementation used.

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml.model

A collection of classes needed to model SCXML documents.

          [**Description**](#package_description)

| **Interface Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[ExternalContent](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/ExternalContent.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | An `ExternalContent` implementation represents an element in the SCXML document that may contain "body content", which means an arbitrary number of child nodes belonging to external namespaces. |
| **[NamespacePrefixesHolder](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/NamespacePrefixesHolder.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | A `NamespacePrefixesHolder` is an entity that retains namespace prefix information from the document for deferred XPath evaluation. |
| **[PathResolverHolder](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/PathResolverHolder.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | A `PathResolverHolder` is an entity that holds a [`PathResolver`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/PathResolver.html "interface in org.apache.commons.scxml"). |

| **Class Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[Action](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Action.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | An abstract base class for executable elements in SCXML, such as <assign>, <log> etc. |
| **[Assign](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Assign.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <assign> SCXML element. |
| **[Cancel](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Cancel.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <cancel> SCXML element. |
| **[CustomAction](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/CustomAction.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | A custom action is simply a tuple consisting of a namespace URI, the local name for the custom action and the corresponding [`Action`](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Action.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model") class. |
| **[Data](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Data.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the SCXML <data> child element of the <datamodel> element. |
| **[Datamodel](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Datamodel.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the SCXML <datamodel> element. |
| **[Else](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Else.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <else> SCXML element. |
| **[ElseIf](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/ElseIf.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <elseif> SCXML element. |
| **[Executable](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Executable.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | An abstract base class for containers of executable elements in SCXML, such as <onentry> and <onexit>. |
| **[Exit](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Exit.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <exit> SCXML element, which is a shorthand notation for an empty anonymous final state. |
| **[Finalize](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Finalize.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <finalize> SCXML element. |
| **[History](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/History.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <history> SCXML pseudo state element. |
| **[If](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/If.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <if> SCXML element, which serves as a container for conditionally executed elements. |
| **[Initial](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Initial.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <initial> SCXML pseudo state element. |
| **[Invoke](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Invoke.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <invoke> SCXML element. |
| **[Log](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Log.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <log> SCXML element. |
| **[OnEntry](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/OnEntry.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <onentry> SCXML element, which is an optional property holding executable content to be run upon entering the parent State or Parallel. |
| **[OnExit](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/OnExit.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <onexit> SCXML element, which is an optional property holding executable content to be run upon exiting the parent State or Parallel. |
| **[Parallel](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Parallel.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <parallel> SCXML element, which is a wrapper element to encapsulate parallel state machines. |
| **[Param](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Param.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <param> SCXML element. |
| **[Path](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Path.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | A helper class for this SCXML implementation that represents the path taken to transition from one TransitionTarget to another in the SCXML document. |
| **[SCXML](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/SCXML.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <scxml> root element, and serves as the "document root". |
| **[Send](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Send.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <send> SCXML element. |
| **[State](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/State.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <state> SCXML element. |
| **[Transition](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Transition.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <transition> SCXML element. |
| **[TransitionTarget](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/TransitionTarget.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | An abstract base class for elements in SCXML that can serve as a <target> for a <transition>, such as State or Parallel. |
| **[Var](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/model/Var.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.model")** | The class in this SCXML object model that corresponds to the <var> SCXML element. |

# How This API Document Is Organized

This API (Application Programming Interface) document has pages corresponding to the items in the navigation bar, described as follows.

### Overview

> The [Overview](overview-summary.html) page is the front page of this API document and provides a list of all packages with a summary for each. This page can also contain an overall description of the set of packages.

### Package

> Each package has a page that contains a list of its classes and interfaces, with a summary for each. This page can contain four categories:
>
> * Interfaces (italic)* Classes* Enums* Exceptions* Errors* Annotation Types

### Class/Interface

> Each class, interface, nested class and nested interface has its own separate page. Each of these pages has three sections consisting of a class/interface description, summary tables, and detailed member descriptions:
>
> * Class inheritance diagram* Direct Subclasses* All Known Subinterfaces* All Known Implementing Classes* Class/interface declaration* Class/interface description
>
>             * Nested Class Summary* Field Summary* Constructor Summary* Method Summary
>
>                     * Field Detail* Constructor Detail* Method Detail
>
> Each summary entry contains the first sentence from the detailed description for that item. The summary entries are alphabetical, while the detailed descriptions are in the order they appear in the source code. This preserves the logical groupings established by the programmer.

### Annotation Type

> Each annotation type has its own separate page with the following sections:
>
> * Annotation Type declaration* Annotation Type description* Required Element Summary* Optional Element Summary* Element Detail

### Enum

> Each enum has its own separate page with the following sections:
>
> * Enum declaration* Enum description* Enum Constant Summary* Enum Constant Detail

### Use

> Each documented package, class and interface has its own Use page. This page describes what packages, classes, methods, constructors and fields use any part of the given class or package. Given a class or interface A, its Use page includes subclasses of A, fields declared as A, methods that return A, and methods and constructors with parameters of type A. You can access this page by first going to the package, class or interface, then clicking on the "Use" link in the navigation bar.

### Tree (Class Hierarchy)

> There is a [Class Hierarchy](overview-tree.html) page for all packages, plus a hierarchy for each package. Each hierarchy page contains a list of classes and a list of interfaces. The classes are organized by inheritance structure starting with `java.lang.Object`. The interfaces do not inherit from `java.lang.Object`.
>
> * When viewing the Overview page, clicking on "Tree" displays the hierarchy for all packages.* When viewing a particular package, class or interface page, clicking "Tree" displays the hierarchy for only that package.

### Deprecated API

> The [Deprecated API](deprecated-list.html) page lists all of the API that have been deprecated. A deprecated API is not recommended for use, generally due to improvements, and a replacement API is usually given. Deprecated APIs may be removed in future implementations.

### Index

> The [Index](index-all.html) contains an alphabetic list of all classes, interfaces, constructors, methods, and fields.

### Prev/Next

These links take you to the next or previous class, interface, package, or related page.

### Frames/No Frames

These links show and hide the HTML frames. All pages are available with or without frames.

### Serialized Form

Each serializable or externalizable class has a description of its serialization fields and methods. This information is of interest to re-implementors, not to developers using the API. While there is no link in the navigation bar, you can get to this information by going to any serialized class and clicking "Serialized Form" in the "See also" section of the class description.

### Constant Field Values

The [Constant Field Values](constant-values.html) page lists the static final fields and their values.

*This help file applies to API documentation generated using the standard doclet.*

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml.env

A collection of classes that may be commonly used to bridge the
SCXML executor to the runtime environment.

**See:**
  
          [**Description**](#package_description)

| **Class Summary** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[AbstractStateMachine](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/env/AbstractStateMachine.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.env")** | This class demonstrates one approach for providing the base functionality needed by classes representing stateful entities, whose behaviors are defined via SCXML documents. |
| **[LogUtils](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/env/LogUtils.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.env")** | Helper methods for Commons SCXML logging. |
| **[SimpleContext](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/env/SimpleContext.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.env")** | Simple Context wrapping a map of variables. |
| **[SimpleDispatcher](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/env/SimpleDispatcher.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.env")** | Trivial EventDispatcher implementation. |
| **[SimpleErrorHandler](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/env/SimpleErrorHandler.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.env")** | Custom error handler that logs the parsing errors in the SCXML document. |
| **[SimpleErrorReporter](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/env/SimpleErrorReporter.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.env")** | Custom error reporter that log execution errors. |
| **[SimpleScheduler](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/env/SimpleScheduler.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.env")** | EventDispatcher implementation that can schedule `delay`ed <send> events for the "scxml" `targettype` attribute value (which is also the default). |
| **[SimpleSCXMLListener](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/env/SimpleSCXMLListener.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.env")** | Simple SCXML Listener that logs execution. |
| **[Tracer](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/env/Tracer.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.env")** | A simple tracer connected to Apache Commons Logging. |
| **[URLResolver](../../../../../org/apache/commons/scxml/env/URLResolver.html "class in org.apache.commons.scxml.env")** | A PathResolver implementation that resolves against a base URL. |

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml.env Description

A collection of classes that may be commonly used to bridge the
SCXML executor to the runtime environment.

Various sub-packages contain specifics related to a particular
environment.

## SCXML 0.5 API

| **Packages** | |
| --- | --- |
| **[org.apache.commons.scxml](org/apache/commons/scxml/package-summary.html)** | The Commons SCXML executor and core concepts. |
| **[org.apache.commons.scxml.env](org/apache/commons/scxml/env/package-summary.html)** | A collection of classes that may be commonly used to bridge the SCXML executor to the runtime environment. |
| **[org.apache.commons.scxml.env.faces](org/apache/commons/scxml/env/faces/package-summary.html)** | A collection of classes bridging the SCXML executor to the JSF-based environments. |
| **[org.apache.commons.scxml.env.jexl](org/apache/commons/scxml/env/jexl/package-summary.html)** | A collection of classes that allow JEXL to be used in expressions within SCXML documents. |
| **[org.apache.commons.scxml.env.jsp](org/apache/commons/scxml/env/jsp/package-summary.html)** | A collection of classes bridging the SCXML executor to the JSP environment. |
| **[org.apache.commons.scxml.env.servlet](org/apache/commons/scxml/env/servlet/package-summary.html)** | A collection of classes useful in the servlet container environment. |
| **[org.apache.commons.scxml.invoke](org/apache/commons/scxml/invoke/package-summary.html)** | A collection of classes related to the SCXML <invoke> element and its children, dealing with the invocation of activities associated with a particular state in the state machine. |
| **[org.apache.commons.scxml.io](org/apache/commons/scxml/io/package-summary.html)** | A collection of classes for reading in and writing out SCXML documents, to and from the Commons SCXML Java object model. |
| **[org.apache.commons.scxml.model](org/apache/commons/scxml/model/package-summary.html)** | A collection of classes needed to model SCXML documents. |
| **[org.apache.commons.scxml.semantics](org/apache/commons/scxml/semantics/package-summary.html)** | A collection of classes responsible for implementations of the `org.apache.commons.scxml.SCXMLSemantics` interface. |
| **[org.apache.commons.scxml.test](org/apache/commons/scxml/test/package-summary.html)** | A collection of classes useful for command line testing. |

## Package org.apache.commons.scxml2.env.javascript Description

A collection of classes that allow JavaScript to be used in expressions
within SCXML documents via the `javax.script` API.
